blocks.text: MARINA BAY, Singapore — The Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC) said it is still exploring additional measures to cushion the impact of the weakening peso on power rates, as industry players are already feeling the toll of current initiatives meant to relieve consumers. Speaking to reporters on Wednesday, ERC chair and CEO Francis Saturnino Juan said recent developments here and abroad, especially amid the Middle East war, have already prompted the commission to tap its usual relief schemes to curb or soften rising prices.
